document.abstract: A projection system for monochrome television was developed in the Philips Eindhoven Laboratory more than 10 years ago. Further work resulted in the development of apparatus for the projection of colored television pictures onto a screen. Projectors have been built giving pictures 22cm by 29 cm and 35 cm by 46 cm at m highlight luminance of 200 candles/sq m (63 mL), and 2.25 m by 3 m at a highlight luminance of 20 candles/sq m (6.3 mL). The projectors were demonstrated before the Color Television Commission of the CCIR in 1955 and 1956.
